rules: Select half-life first, age penalty second, and a shared offense-defense player penalty third on Season 2025 only.
Always compare with an unweighted, no-age 3000/3000/300 five-year RAPM on identical games.
Score the candidate using each player's actual age in the scored season.
Publish current-age player coefficients by adding the observed final-season age effect; do not publish an all-age-27 leaderboard.
Season 2026 is a reused diagnostic and Season 2027 remains untouched.
